strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Van Sales and Field Sales Rep Software
strings.tierB.home.description: Software for distributors: invoices and receipts from the rep’s phone, van stock, collections, routes and visits. Works offline and syncs later.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Run your field sales reps from the first visit to the last collection
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales is a cloud platform for distribution and wholesale companies that run field sales reps. Reps issue and print invoices and receipts from their phone, track van stock and log visits, while managers see sales, collections and customer balances as they happen.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoices from the rep’s phone
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Reps issue the invoice at the customer’s door and print it on a Bluetooth thermal printer before leaving the shop.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Collections and customer balances
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Every payment gets a numbered receipt linked to the invoices it pays, and the customer’s balance and statement update at once.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Van stock custody
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Each van’s stock is tracked item by item: loaded, sold, returned and remaining, so a gap shows up the same day.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Routes and visits
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Visits are logged with location, time and photos, and each rep’s route is drawn on the map for the manager.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: Works offline
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Reps keep selling with no signal. Documents wait on the phone and sync automatically, without duplicates, when the connection returns.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard for managers
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sales, collections, returns, stock and rep performance in one place, with roles and permissions for every user.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tell us how you sell
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Request a quote or book a meeting. We look at your reps, routes, products and invoicing needs.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Set up your company
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Add products, prices, customers and reps, and set your country’s currency and tax rate in the settings.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Send reps to the field
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Reps install the app on Android or iPhone, load their van and start selling, printing and collecting.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Follow the day as it happens
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: The web dashboard shows sales, collections, van stock and visits while reps are still on the road.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales is a cloud platform for managing field sales reps in distribution and wholesale companies. It covers van sales, route sales, pre-sales and direct store delivery (DSD). Reps invoice, print, collect and log visits from their phone, and managers follow sales, collections, van stock and customer balances from a web dashboard.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yes. The rep app keeps working without internet: reps issue and print invoices and receipts, log visits and add customers, and everything syncs automatically without duplicates when the connection returns. One exception applies in Saudi Arabia: companies with e-invoicing integration enabled need a connection at the moment an invoice or a return is issued.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales serves distribution companies in every country. Each company sets its own currency and tax rate in its settings, and invoices, receipts and reports use them. The company is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and onboarding is done online through meetings, WhatsApp and remote support.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: Does FieldSales connect to government e-invoicing systems?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: We support Phase 2 integration with ZATCA’s Fatoora platform. This applies to companies in Saudi Arabia. In other countries, FieldSales issues invoices with your currency and tax rate, and a connection to a national e-invoicing system is available on request, after we review that country’s requirements with you. We make no promise of conformity outside Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Which languages is the FieldSales app available in?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: The FieldSales app interface is available in Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese, and only in these languages. Reps and managers can switch the interface language, and printed invoices can carry a second language next to the main one. Website pages in other languages are translations for information about the product.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: How do I get started with FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Request a quote, book a meeting or message us on WhatsApp. We learn how your reps work, then help you set up products, prices, customers and reps. Reps install the app on Android or iPhone, and managers use the web dashboard from any browser. Smartphones are the only hardware you need.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: The FieldSales app interface is available in Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese. Pages in other languages describe the product for information only.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van Sales Software for Distributors | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Van sales and route sales software: invoices printed from the rep’s phone, van stock per item, collections and visits. Works offline.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Van sales software for distributors and wholesalers
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales is van sales software for companies whose reps sell from a vehicle on daily routes. The rep loads the van, sells at each shop, prints the invoice, collects payment and records returns from one phone app. The manager sees what was loaded, sold, collected and left in every van.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: What is van sales software?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Van sales software, also called cash van or route sales software, runs a sales model where the rep carries stock in the vehicle and sells, delivers, invoices and collects in a single visit. It replaces paper invoice books and end-of-day phone calls. It records every sale, payment and return as a document, so stock and cash can be checked against each other the same day. For a manager, it answers three questions every evening: what did each rep sell, what did each rep collect, and what is still in each van.
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: A day in the field
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: The day starts with a documented load from the warehouse to the van. At each shop the rep opens the customer, adds items by list or barcode, issues the invoice and prints it on a thermal printer. Payment is recorded with a receipt, and any return is logged with its reason. At the end of the day, what remains in the van is unloaded back to the warehouse. Between those steps, the manager can follow each rep’s sales, collections and visits from the web dashboard without calling anyone.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Built for weak signal
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Distribution routes pass through basements, industrial areas and villages with poor coverage. The FieldSales rep app stores customers, products and prices on the phone, so the rep can issue and print documents without internet. Each document carries a unique key, so it uploads once, even if the upload is retried. Saudi companies with e-invoicing integration enabled need a connection at the moment invoices and returns are issued. Receipts, visits and new customers still work offline for them.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Collections and van custody
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Cash on the road needs the same control as stock. Every collection gets a numbered receipt that can be linked to the invoices it pays, and the customer’s balance updates at once. Van stock is calculated per item as loaded minus sold, plus returns and documented adjustments, so managers can compare it with a physical count before the rep goes home. Returns can be classified as normal, damaged or exchange, and the manager decides whether returned goods go back into the van’s sellable stock.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Who it is for
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales suits distributors and wholesalers of fast-moving goods such as food, beverages, cleaning products and personal care, and any company with reps who visit shops on routes. It supports van sales, pre-sales orders and direct store delivery. It is not a full ERP: it connects to your accounting or ERP system through an API. Managers control what each rep may do, such as giving discounts, selling below the list price or adding new customers.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: What is the difference between van sales and pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: In van sales the rep carries stock and delivers, invoices and collects in the same visit. In pre-sales the rep takes an order that the warehouse delivers later. FieldSales supports both, so a company can run cash vans on some routes and order-taking on others. In both models, invoices, collections and customer balances live in the same system, and managers see them in the same reports.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: How do I reconcile a van at the end of the day?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales shows, for each item in each van, the quantity loaded, sold, returned and remaining. Compare the remaining figure with a physical count, record any difference as a documented adjustment, then unload the rest back to the warehouse with one movement. The van starts the next day with a clean, known balance.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: What hardware does a van sales rep need?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: A smartphone, Android or iPhone. A Bluetooth thermal printer is optional and lets the rep hand a printed invoice or receipt to the customer. FieldSales does not sell hardware or require a specific printer brand. Managers use the web dashboard from any computer or phone browser.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: Can FieldSales connect to our accounting system?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yes. FieldSales offers an API that lets your accounting or ERP system exchange customers, products, invoices, receipts and stock movements with the platform. Your team or integrator builds the connection using the API documentation.

Each company chooses its country, currency and tax rate in its settings, and invoices, receipts and reports follow them. Government e-invoicing integration is live in Saudi Arabia only. strings.tierB.about.title: About FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales builds cloud software for distribution companies that run field sales reps. Founded in 2026 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (Arabic name فيلد سيلز) is a cloud platform for distribution and wholesale companies that run field sales reps. The company was founded in 2026 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. It serves companies in every country, with the currency and tax rate of each country set in the company’s own settings. Our customers are companies that sell and deliver through reps on the road: distributors, wholesalers and manufacturers with their own sales fleet.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: We build one connected system for the whole field cycle: invoices printed from the rep’s phone, receipts and customer balances, van stock custody, routes and visits with location and photos, and a web dashboard for managers. The rep app runs on Android and iPhone and keeps working without internet, then syncs when the connection returns. Companies can connect FieldSales to their accounting or ERP system through an API, so field data does not have to be typed in twice.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: We describe the product as it is. We support Phase 2 integration with ZATCA’s Fatoora platform. Integration with government systems in other countries is available on request. The app interface is available in Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese. To talk to us, request a quote, book a meeting or send us a message on WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Contact FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Talk to the FieldSales team: request a quote, book a meeting or chat on WhatsApp about field sales and van sales software.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tell us how your reps sell today and what you want to change. Request a quote, book a meeting or message us on WhatsApp, and a member of our team will reply. For support, existing customers can use the same channels. It helps to mention your country, the number of reps and whether they sell from vans, take orders or both.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Book an online meeting with our team. We will walk through a rep’s day in the app and the manager’s dashboard, using examples close to your products and routes, and answer your questions about setup.
strings.tierA.features.title: FieldSales Features: Invoicing, Van Stock, Routes
strings.tierA.features.description: Every FieldSales feature for field sales teams: offline invoicing and printing, van stock and collections, routes and visits, and a manager dashboard.
strings.tierA.features.intro: FieldSales covers the full cycle of a field sales day: loading the van, selling and printing at the shop, collecting payment, logging the visit and closing the day. Each feature below is part of one system, so an invoice updates stock, the customer’s balance and the manager’s reports at the same time. Reps work from an app on Android or iPhone that keeps running without internet. Managers work from a web dashboard with roles and permissions for each user. Behind both are the basics a distributor needs every day: products with several units and price lists, customers with credit limits and statements, returns with reasons, and reports by rep, customer, product and period.
strings.tierA.featurePages.offlineInvoicing.titl: Offline Invoicing and Thermal Printing | FieldSales
strings.tierA.featurePages.offlineInvoicing.desc: Reps issue and print invoices and receipts from their phone without internet. Documents sync later, once, with no duplicates.
strings.tierA.featurePages.offlineInvoicing.h1: Offline invoicing and thermal printing for field reps
strings.tierA.featurePages.offlineInvoicing.intr: A rep standing in a shop with no signal should not have to write on paper and type it in later. FieldSales keeps customers, products and prices on the phone, so the rep issues the invoice, prints it on a Bluetooth thermal printer and hands it to the customer without internet. The document uploads automatically when the connection returns.
strings.tierA.featurePages.offlineInvoicing.poin: Data on the phone before the signal drops

On the first connection, the app downloads customers, products, prices and company settings to the phone. When the network goes down, everything needed to issue an invoice is already there, with no empty lists or loading screens. Documents are saved in the phone’s storage, so they survive if the app is closed or the phone restarts.

Invoices and receipts print on a Bluetooth thermal printer paired with the phone. Printing happens on the device, so it works with or without internet. Amounts print in the company’s currency with the right number of decimal places. Receipt vouchers print the same way, at the moment the payment is collected.

Every document gets a unique key on the phone when it is created, and the server refuses duplicates. If the upload fails and retries several times, you still get one invoice. Invoices upload before the receipts that refer to them, and older documents before newer ones, so links between them stay intact.

A counter shows how many documents are still waiting to upload. If the server rejects a document for a business reason, the rep sees it marked as rejected. Saudi companies with e-invoicing integration enabled need a connection when invoices and returns are issued; receipts and visits still work offline.
Can reps print invoices without internet?

Yes. Printing happens on the phone, so an invoice issued offline is printed offline and uploaded later. Saudi companies with e-invoicing integration enabled need a connection at the moment invoices and returns are issued, then print from the phone as usual.

A portable Bluetooth thermal printer that pairs with the rep’s phone. FieldSales does not sell printers or require a specific brand. Receipts print on the same printer as invoices, at the moment the payment is collected.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.title: Van Stock and Collections Software | FieldSales
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.description: Track each van’s stock item by item and every collection with a numbered receipt. Loaded, sold, returned and remaining, live.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.h1: Van stock custody and collections in one place
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.intro: You know what was loaded in the morning and what was sold, but the difference often appears only at the monthly stock count. FieldSales records every movement of van stock and every payment as a document, so stock and cash can be checked each day, item by item and customer by customer.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.points.0.bod: Loading moves stock from the warehouse to the van, unloading moves it back, and adjustments are recorded with a written reason. Each movement shows who recorded it, the rep or the office, so responsibility is clear. Loading a van reduces the central warehouse, and unloading adds back to it, so no stock is counted twice.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.points.1.tit: Live balance per item per van
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.points.1.bod: The remaining quantity of each item in each van is calculated as it changes: loaded minus sold, plus returns and adjustments. Managers see which item does not match today, not a single unexplained number at month end. Damaged and expired returns are kept apart from sellable stock in the van.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.points.2.bod: Each collection by cash, transfer or cheque gets a numbered receipt that can be linked to the invoices it pays. The customer’s balance and statement update at once, and credit limits warn the rep before selling on credit beyond them.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.points.3.tit: An honest picture of the van
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.points.3.bod: The remaining quantity is calculated from documents, not counted. It shows what should be in the van and reveals missing movements. A physical count at day end, recorded as an adjustment, closes the loop. We say this plainly because a calculated balance is not a count, and a manager should know which one is on the screen.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.faq.0.q: Does FieldSales detect van stock shortages?
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.faq.0.a: It shows what should be in each van based on recorded movements, and flags gaps such as an item sold beyond what was loaded. A real physical shortage appears when you compare the calculated balance with a physical count and record the difference as an adjustment.
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.faq.1.q: Can one receipt pay several invoices?
strings.tierA.featurePages.vanStock.faq.1.a: Yes. A receipt can be linked to the invoices it pays, and each invoice shows how much has been paid and how much is still due. The customer’s statement lists invoices, receipts and returns in order, with the running balance. Managers can see collections by rep and by payment method for any period.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.title: Rep Route and Visit Tracking | FieldSales
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.descript: Log every rep visit with location, time and photos, see each rep’s route on the map and plan visit order by distance.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.h1: Routes and visits you can verify
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.intro: A rep says they visited fourteen customers. FieldSales turns that into evidence: each visit is saved with its location, time and photos, and the route between customers is drawn on the map. Supervisors stop arguing about who went where and start working from the same record.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.points.0: Location and time on every visit

The rep’s coordinates are captured when the visit is logged and saved with it. Visit duration is calculated on the server from entry and exit times, not from a number sent by the phone. The accuracy of each location point is stored with it, so a weak reading indoors is not treated as certain.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.points.1: Reps attach photos from the phone camera: the shelf, the shop front, the products on display. Managers see the state of each outlet, not only a description of it. This gives sales and trade marketing teams a simple way to check shelf execution across many shops.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.points.2: Location points become a route that follows the streets. Segments built from recorded points and segments estimated between distant points are drawn differently, and the dashboard shows how much of each, so an estimate is never read as fact.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.points.3: FieldSales can order a rep’s customers by their locations to shorten the day’s route, and the new order can be undone. Visits can be logged offline and upload later without duplicates, because the farthest customers are often the ones with the weakest signal.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.faq.0.q: How do I know a rep really visited a customer?
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.faq.0.a: Each visit is saved with its coordinates, time and photos. Compare the visit location with the customer’s saved location and review the attached photos. It is a record, not a verbal report.
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.faq.1.q: What do solid and dashed lines on the route map mean?
strings.tierA.featurePages.routesVisits.faq.1.a: A solid line is a path built from recorded GPS points matched to roads. A dashed line is the most likely road between two distant points, estimated by the routing engine. The dashboard shows the distance of each, so the estimate is not mistaken for a recorded path. An estimated segment alone should not be used as proof of where a rep drove.
strings.tierA.apps.title: FieldSales Apps: Android, iPhone and Web
strings.tierA.apps.description: The FieldSales rep app runs on Android and iPhone and in the phone browser. Managers use a web dashboard from any computer or phone.
strings.tierA.apps.h1: FieldSales on Android, iPhone and the web
strings.tierA.apps.body: The rep app is available on Google Play for Android and on the App Store for iPhone, and it also runs in the phone browser without installation. Reps use it to sell, print invoices and receipts on a Bluetooth thermal printer, collect payments, manage van stock and log visits, with or without internet. Managers and office staff use the web dashboard from any browser, on a computer or a phone, to follow sales, collections, stock, routes and reports, and to set up products, prices, customers, reps and permissions. Nothing needs to be installed on office computers. The app interface is available in Arabic, English, French, Turkish and Chinese. Each company’s data is kept separate from other companies, and every user sees only what their role allows.
strings.tierA.quote.title: Request a Quote | FieldSales
strings.tierA.quote.description: Get a FieldSales quote for your field sales team. Tell us about your reps and needs, and we will send a quote that fits your operation.
strings.tierA.quote.body: We do not publish prices on the website, because each quote depends on how your team works. Tell us your country, how many reps and office users you have, and which features you need, such as van stock, routes and visits or government e-invoicing in Saudi Arabia. We will reply with a quote and answer your questions. If you prefer to talk first, book a meeting or message us on WhatsApp. A quote covers the subscription for your company, and we can also explain how setup works, how reps are trained and what information we need from you to get started.
